prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: macOS application icon, 1024 x 1024 square PNG
Primary request: Design a polished macOS app icon for Hermes Dashboard using the supplied final pixel-art girl as the exact character reference.
Subject: the same black-bob-haired girl with over-ear headphones, ivory face, black-and-ivory outfit, seated at the same gray laptop, small four-petal white logo.
Style/medium: crisp retro pixel art with deliberate square pixels, matching the supplied character; polished app-icon finish.
Composition/framing: centered character and laptop, large and readable at Dock size, inside a rounded-square tile. Keep comfortable padding around hair and laptop.
Scene/backdrop: deep navy-to-black rounded-square background with a restrained cyan and violet pixel glow and a thin cyan pixel border; transparent outside the rounded corners.
Lighting/mood: calm futuristic dashboard ambience.
Color palette: black, deep navy, ivory, gray, cyan, small violet accents.
Constraints: preserve the supplied character identity, hairstyle, headphones, facial proportions, outfit, laptop pose and four-petal logo. No words, no letters, no Hermes staff symbol, no extra characters, no watermark. Make the silhouette clear at 32px and 64px.
postprocess: Applied an antialiased rounded-square alpha mask to remove the generated checkerboard outside the tile; resized to 1024x1024; generated AppIcon.icns from standard macOS icon sizes.
